local gun = script.Parent

local configFolder = gun:FindFirstChild("配置")
local c_shotCD = configFolder:WaitForChild("发射间隔")
local c_damage = configFolder:FindFirstChild("伤害")
local c_bulletMax = configFolder:FindFirstChild("子弹上限")
local c_addBullet = configFolder:FindFirstChild("恢复子弹数量")
local c_addBulletCD = configFolder:FindFirstChild("子弹恢复时长")

local v_bulletNum = gun:WaitForChild("bulletNum")
local v_nextFireTime = gun:WaitForChild("nextFireTime")
local v_lastAddBulletTime = gun:WaitForChild("lastAddBulletTime")

gun.FireC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player,hit:BasePart,endPos:Vector3) 
	if v_bulletNum.Value <= 0 then return end
	
	local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if timeNow <= v_nextFireTime.Value then return end
	
	v_lastAddBulletTime.Value = timeNow -- 重置时间，要停止射击才会恢复子弹
	
	-- 下一次开火时间
	v_nextFireTime.Value = timeNow + c_shotCD.Value
	v_bulletNum.Value -= 1
	
	local isNpc,npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
	if isNpc then
		local damage = c_damage.Value
		if hit.Name == "Head" then
			damage *= 2
			GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(endPos - player.Character:GetPivot().Position).Unit)
		end
		GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage)
		GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
	end
	--GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C:FireAllClients(gun,endPos)
	gun.FireS2C:FireAllClients(endPos)
end)

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(c_addBulletCD.Value)
	local lastTime = v_lastAddBulletTime.Value
	local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	v_lastAddBulletTime.Value = timeNow
	if v_bulletNum.Value < c_bulletMax.Value then
		local addNum = math.floor((timeNow - lastTime) / c_addBulletCD.Value) * c_addBullet.Value
		v_bulletNum.Value = math.clamp(v_bulletNum.Value + addNum,1,c_bulletMax.Value)
	end
end"},{"id":43,"text":"if script:IsDescendantOf(workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs")) then return end

function playLaser(endPos:Vector3)
	FireSound:Play()
	local FirePoint:Attachment = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	local startPos
	if FirePoint then
		startPos = FirePoint.WorldCFrame.Position
	else
		local humanoidRootPart:Part = LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		startPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
	end
	local offset = endPos - startPos
	local dir = offset.Unit
	local distance = offset.Magnitude

	local effect = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("激光"):Clone()
	effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startPos + distance * 0.5 * dir,endPos))
	effect.Parent = workspace
	
	local tweenPart = effect:WaitForChild("激光")
	local originSize = tweenPart.Size
	tweenPart.Size = Vector3.new(distance,originSize.Y,originSize.Z)
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1)
	game.TweenService:Create(tweenPart,tweenInfo,{
		Size = Vector3.new(distance,0.1,0.1),
		Transparency = 1
	}):Play()
	game.Debris:AddItem(effect,tweenInfo.Time)
	
	-- 发光
	pointLight.Enabled = true
	par.Enabled = true
	task.wait(c_shotCD.Value)
	pointLight.Enabled = false
	par.Enabled = false
end

gun.Equipped:Connect(function(mouse: Mouse) 
	if gun.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	
	mouse.Icon = "rbxassetid://316279304"
	
	local c_bulletMax = configFolder:WaitForChild("子弹上限")
	
	local FireC2S = gun:WaitForChild("FireC2S")
	local v_bulletNum:IntValue = gun:WaitForChild("bulletNum")
	local v_nextFireTime:NumberValue = gun:WaitForChild("nextFireTime")
	
	local ui = gun:WaitForChild("LaserPistolBulletFrame"):Clone()
	ui.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.UIInterface

	local idleTrack:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,112057956553263)
	idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
	idleTrack.Looped = true
	idleTrack:Play()
	
	-- 加载开火动画
	local fireTrack:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,82124648755414)
	fireTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3
	fireTrack.Looped = false
	fireTrack:Stop()
	
	local onBulletChanged = function()
		ui:WaitForChild("t_bullet").Text = string.format("%d/%d",v_bulletNum.Value,c_bulletMax.Value)
	end
	
	onBulletChanged()
	local conBullet = v_bulletNum.Changed:Connect(onBulletChanged)
	
	local con = gun.Activated:Connect(function() 
		if v_bulletNum.Value <= 0 then
			EmptySound:Play()
			return
		end
		
		local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		if timeNow <= v_nextFireTime.Value then return end
		
		v_nextFireTime.Value = timeNow + c_shotCD.Value
		
		local FirePoint:Attachment = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
		local endPos:Vector3 = GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
		local rayOrigin:Vector3
		if FirePoint then
			rayOrigin = FirePoint.WorldCFrame.Position
		else
			local humanoidRootPart:Part = LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			rayOrigin = humanoidRootPart.Position
		end

		local rayDirection:Vector3 = (endPos - rayOrigin).Unit * 300
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		--raycastParams:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character) -- 排除玩家角色
		raycastParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
		raycastParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.ResourcesItem))
		raycastParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))

		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin,rayDirection,raycastParams)

		local hit:BasePart
		if hitResult then
			hit = hitResult.Instance
			endPos = hitResult.Position
			-- print(hit.Name)
		end

		local isNpc,npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)

		task.spawn(function()
			--GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(tool,endPos)
			playLaser(endPos)
		end)
		fireTrack:Play()
		GameHelper.onMyGunFire:Fire(hit,endPos)
		if isNpc then
			GameHelper.onMyGunHitNpc:Fire(npc,hit,endPos)
		end
		
		FireC2S:FireServer(hit,endPos)
	end)
	
	gun.Unequipped:Once(function() 
		mouse.Icon = ""
		if idleTrack then
			idleTrack:Stop()
			idleTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if ui then
			ui:Destroy()
			ui = nil
		end
		if con then
			con:Disconnect()
			con = nil
		end
		conBullet:Disconnect()
	end)
end)

FireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(endPos:Vector3) 
	if gun.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	playLaser(endPos)

	local lastTime = v_lastAddBulletTime.Value

		local addNum = math.floor((timeNow - lastTime) / v_addBulletCD.Value) * c_addBullet.Value
		v_bulletNum.Value = math.clamp(v_bulletNum.Value + addNum,1,v_bulletNumMax.Value)
	end

	v_bulletNum.Value -= 1

local CollectionService=game:GetService("CollectionService")
local GameEnum=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local GameHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local AudioHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local UIHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local GunValue=ValueHelper.ValueModel.GunValue
local tool=script.Parent
ValueHelper:InitByModel(tool,GunValue)
tool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BarrelPistol4)
local config=tool:FindFirstChild("配置")
local c_reloadNum=config:FindFirstChild("装填子弹数量")
local c_bulletId=config:FindFirstChild("子弹id")
local c_damage=config:FindFirstChild("每发子弹伤害")
local c_shotCD=config:FindFirstChild("发射间隔")
local v_reloading=ValueHelper:FindValue(tool,GunValue.reloading)
local v_bulletAmount=ValueHelper:FindValue(tool,GunValue.bulletAmount)
local v_reloadCompleteTime=ValueHelper:FindValue(tool,GunValue.reloadCompleteTime)
v_bulletAmount.Value=c_reloadNum.Value
local burstKey=nil
local burstStarted=0
local burstCount=0

local function reload(player)
	if tool.Parent~=player.Character or v_reloading.Value then return end
	local bulletLo=ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(c_bulletId.Value)
	local playerBullet=bulletLo and GameHelper:GetCurBulletValue(player,bulletLo.ItemType)
	if not playerBullet then return end
	if playerBullet.Value<=0 then AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"Empty Gun Sound") UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"Insufficient ammunition!",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn) return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value==c_reloadNum.Value then return end
	v_reloading.Value=true
	v_reloadCompleteTime.Value=workspace.DistributedGameTime+config:FindFirstChild("装填时长").Value
	local cost=math.min(playerBullet.Value,c_reloadNum.Value-v_bulletAmount.Value)
	playerBullet.Value-=cost
	task.wait(config:FindFirstChild("装填时长").Value)
	if not tool.Parent then return end
	v_reloading.Value=false
	v_bulletAmount.Value+=cost
end
local function finite(v) return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and v.X==v.X and v.Y==v.Y and v.Z==v.Z end

tool.TryFireC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,claimedHit,endPos,firePoint,shotToken)
	if tool.Parent~=player.Character or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or v_reloading.Value then return end
	if not finite(endPos) or not firePoint or not firePoint:IsA("Attachment") or not firePoint:IsDescendantOf(tool.FirePoints) then return end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local key=type(shotToken)=="number" and shotToken or "legacy"
	if key~=burstKey or now-burstStarted>0.25 then
		if now-burstStarted<math.max(0.1,c_shotCD.Value*0.9) then return end
		burstKey=key burstStarted=now burstCount=0
	end
	burstCount+=1
	if burstCount>#tool.FirePoints:GetChildren() then return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value<=0 then task.spawn(reload,player) return end
	local origin=firePoint.WorldPosition
	local delta=endPos-origin
	if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 or delta.Magnitude>55 then return end
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,delta.Unit*50,params)
	local hit=result and result.Instance or nil
	local actualEnd=result and result.Position or origin+delta.Unit*50
	v_bulletAmount.Value-=1
	local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
	if isNpc then
		local critical=hit.Name=="Head"
		local damage=c_damage.Value*(critical and 2 or 1)
		if critical then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(actualEnd-player.Character:GetPivot().Position).Unit) end
		if GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=actualEnd,IsCritical=critical,ShotToken=shotToken,RangedWeapon=true}) then GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage) end
	end
	tool.FireS2C:FireAllClients(actualEnd,firePoint,isNpc==true)
end)
GameHelper.GunReloadC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(reload)

local CommonFunc=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local GameHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local AudioHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local RangedCombatClient=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("RangedCombatClient"))
local LocalPlayer=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local featureSwitch=game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版移动端射击视角")
local GunValue=ValueHelper.ValueModel.GunValue
local tool=script.Parent
local c_shotCD=tool:WaitForChild("配置"):WaitForChild("发射间隔")
local v_reloading=ValueHelper:WaitValue(tool,GunValue.reloading)
local v_bulletAmount=ValueHelper:WaitValue(tool,GunValue.bulletAmount)
local nextFireTime=0
local active=false
local idleTrack
local fireTrack

local function spreadDirection(direction:Vector3)
	local frame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,direction)
	local angle=math.rad(1.15)
	local radius=math.sqrt(math.random())*math.tan(angle)
	local theta=math.random()*math.pi*2
	return frame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.cos(theta)*radius,math.sin(theta)*radius,-1)).Unit
end
local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character or v_reloading.Value then return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value<=0 then GameHelper.GunReloadC2S:FireServer() return end
	local now=workspace.DistributedGameTime
	if now<nextFireTime then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then shotContext=RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext) if not shotContext then return end end
	nextFireTime=now+c_shotCD.Value
	if fireTrack then fireTrack:Play() end
	local aimTarget=shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	local points=tool.FirePoints:GetChildren()
	local fireTimes=math.min(v_bulletAmount.Value,#points)
	for index=1,fireTimes do
		local firePoint=points[index]
		local origin=firePoint.WorldPosition
		local delta=aimTarget-origin
		if delta.Magnitude>0.001 then
			local direction
			if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
				direction=spreadDirection(delta.Unit)
			else
				local distance=(LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot().Position-aimTarget).Magnitude
				local legacyTarget=aimTarget+CommonFunc:RandomVector3(distance/50)
				local legacyDelta=legacyTarget-origin
				if legacyDelta.Magnitude<=0.001 then continue end
				direction=legacyDelta.Unit
			end
			local params=RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction*50,params)
			local hit=result and result.Instance or nil
			local actualEnd=result and result.Position or origin+direction*50
			local hitCharacter=GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)==true
			task.spawn(function() GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(tool,actualEnd,firePoint,hitCharacter) end)
			tool.TryFireC2S:FireServer(hit,actualEnd,firePoint,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
		end
	end
end
local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(tool,shoot) end
end
v_reloading.Changed:Connect(function() if v_reloading.Value then AudioHelper:PlayEffect("Gun-Reload",tool:WaitForChild("Handle")) end end)
tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	if tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	active=true
	idleTrack=CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character,112057956553263)
	idleTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2 idleTrack.Looped=true idleTrack:Play()
	fireTrack=CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character,82124648755414)
	fireTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3 fireTrack.Looped=false
	RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(tool)
	bindNewInput()
end)
tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	active=false
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(tool)
	if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() idleTrack:Destroy() idleTrack=nil end
	if fireTrack then fireTrack:Stop() fireTrack:Destroy() fireTrack=nil end
end)
tool.Activated:Connect(function() if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then shoot(nil) end end)
featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(bindNewInput)
UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(bindNewInput)
tool.FireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(endPos,firePoint,hitCharacter)
	if tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(tool,endPos,firePoint,hitCharacter) end
end)
